predict: HippoRAG is a novel retrieval framework, specifically a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) framework, that serves as a long-term memory for Large Language Models (LLMs). It is inspired by the neurobiological process of the hippocampus, where salient signals are included in the hippocampal index and associated with each other. HippoRAG is designed to improve the performance of LLMs by providing a more efficient and effective way of retrieving and storing information. It can be combined with standard multi-step retrieval methods, such as IRCoT, to achieve strong complementary improvements.
